name: Gauges
author: Aziz Uysal
description: CPU, memory, GPU, disk and network in the bar as small live graphs, each with a detail panel: history graphs, per-core load, temperatures, top processes, volumes and interfaces.

barWidget.description: Live CPU, memory, GPU, disk and network readings as graphs, gauges, numbers or icons, each opening a detail panel.

schema.label: CPU
schema.description: How processor load is shown in the bar. Graph draws recent load; Gauge and Pie draw the current level; Off leaves it out.

schema.label: Memory
schema.description: How memory in use is shown in the bar. Graph draws recent use; Gauge and Pie draw the current level; Off leaves it out.

schema.label: GPU
schema.description: How graphics load is shown in the bar. Graph draws recent load; Gauge and Pie draw the current level; Off leaves it out.

schema.label: Disk
schema.description: How space used on the system disk is shown in the bar. Graph draws recent read and write activity; Gauge and Pie draw the current level; Off leaves it out.

schema.label: Network
schema.description: How network traffic is shown in the bar. Graph draws recent upload above a middle line and download below it; Rates shows both speeds as numbers; Off leaves it out.

schema.label: Show the number beside graphs, gauges and pies
Show IPv6 addresses
schema.description: Lists each connection's IPv6 address under its IPv4 one in the network panel.

schema.label: Show public address
schema.description: Shows the address the internet sees you at, with its country's flag, in the network panel. Finding it asks Cloudflare (https://1.1.1.1/cdn-cgi/trace) each time the panel is opened, at most once every ten minutes. Off, nothing is asked.

schema.label: Warning level (%)
schema.description: Memory and disk turn the warning colour when this full.
